title: Ek code, do logon ke points
caption:
Koi apna aapke saath Waypoint par aaye, toh kise bulayenge? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young woman who shares her Waypoint invite code with her cousin; when the cousin redeems it in her first week, both get ten points. Waypoint is for adults 18 and over and is not a counselling or crisis service.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Priya: Priya is a woman in her mid twenties with shoulder-length hair, a mustard kurta and small earrings.
cast.Neha: Neha is Priya's cousin, a woman of about twenty-two with a ponytail and a denim jacket.

scenes.vo: प्रिया और नेहा बचपन से हर बात बाँटती थीं।
scenes.sub: Priya aur Neha bachpan se har baat baantti thin.
scenes.art: Priya and Neha laughing together on a rooftop terrace with potted plants, evening sky.

scenes.vo: फिर नेहा नौकरी के लिए दूसरे शहर चली गई।
scenes.sub: Phir Neha naukri ke liye doosre shehar chali gayi.
scenes.art: Neha with a suitcase at a railway platform, Priya waving goodbye.

scenes.vo: फ़ोन पर बात कम होने लगी।
scenes.sub: Phone par baat kam hone lagi.
scenes.art: Priya alone on the same terrace at night, looking at her phone, city lights behind.

scenes.vo: प्रिया रोज़ वेपॉइंट की वॉल पर अपना दिन लिखती थी।
scenes.sub: Priya roz Waypoint ki wall par apna din likhti thi.
scenes.art: Priya sitting cross-legged on her bed typing on her phone with a soft smile, a lamp beside her.

scenes.vo: उसने सोचा, नेहा भी यहाँ होती तो अच्छा लगता।
scenes.sub: Usne socha, Neha bhi yahan hoti toh achchha lagta.
scenes.art: Priya looking up thoughtfully from her phone, a framed photo of the two cousins on the shelf.

scenes.vo: उसने अपना इनवाइट कोड निकाला और नेहा को भेज दिया।
scenes.sub: Usne apna invite code nikaala aur Neha ko bhej diya.

scenes.vo: नेहा ने उसी हफ़्ते नया अकाउंट बनाया।
scenes.sub: Neha ne usi hafte naya account banaaya.
scenes.art: Neha in a small rented room in another city, sitting by a window with her phone, smiling.

scenes.vo: कोड डाला, तो दोनों को दस दस पॉइंट मिले।
scenes.sub: Code daala, toh dono ko das das point mile.
scenes.art: Split view: Priya on her bed and Neha by her window, both looking at their phones happily.

scenes.vo: अब दोनों एक ही वॉल पर अपनी बातें लिखती हैं।
scenes.sub: Ab dono ek hi wall par apni baatein likhti hain.
scenes.art: Priya laughing at her phone on the terrace in daylight.

scenes.vo: दूर रहकर भी थोड़ा पास लगने लगा।
scenes.sub: Door rehkar bhi thoda paas lagne laga.
scenes.art: Neha walking to work with her phone in hand and a light smile, a busy street behind.
Close-up of Priya smiling at the viewer, terrace plants softly blurred behind.
